chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Ibn Sinan, from Habib, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

A man from this group was mentioned in his presence, who had been appointed to a position of authority. He said: 'How does he treat his brethren?' I said: 'There is no goodness in his conduct.' He said: 'Uff! They are entering into what is not befitting for them, and they are not doing good for their brethren.'

key_terms.أُفٍّ: An expression of disapproval or contempt
key_terms.الْعِصَابَةِ: The group/clan (referring to a specific faction or group)

ai.seo_question: What did the Imam say about a man appointed to authority who lacks goodness towards his brethren?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) critiques a man from the 'Uthmani faction (al-'Ishaba) appointed to government, highlighting his failure in 'adl (justice) and kindness towards his fellow Muslims. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis that political legitimacy is contingent not just on authority, but on ethical conduct and proper treatment of the community, distinguishing true leadership from mere administrative appointment.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Ibn Abu Najran, from Ibn Sinan, from Habeeb, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘It was mentioned in his<sup>asws</sup> presence, a man from this group who had become in charge of governmental affairs. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘How does he deal with his brethren?’ I said, ‘There is no goodness in his presence’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Uff! They are entering into what is not befitting for them and they are not doing anything good for their brethren!’
en.sarwar: 2. Abu Ali al-Ash’ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘ Abd al-Jabbar from ibn abu Najran from ibn Sinan from Habib from abu Basir who has said the following:

“In the presence of abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, a man of this group (followers of ‘A’immah) was mentioned and that he had become the in charge person of an official position of the rulers. He (the Imam) asked, ‘How is his dealing with his brothers in belief ? 5 I (the narrator) replied, ‘There is nothing good in him in this issue . 5 He (the Imam) said, ‘It is awful. They involve themselves in something which they are not supposed to do; then they do not do anything good for their brothers in belief . 555
